title: CodeFarmer configuration
description: Project or user configuration for the CodeFarmer CLI. Provider API keys are supplied through environment variables or the local credentials file and cannot be stored here.

oneOf.description: Built-in provider (openai, gemini, grok, deepseek, kimi, opencode-go) or the id of a customEndpoints entry.
Inline custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint; id defaults to the baseURL hostname.

id.description: Optional unique id; must not collide with built-in provider names.

baseURL.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL without credentials, query, or fragment.

apiKeyEnv.description: Environment variable holding the API key; falls back to CODEFARMER_API_KEY and the local credentials file.

apiKeyOptional.description: Set true for local keyless endpoints (e.g. Ollama, vLLM) to skip the API key check.

provider.description: Built-in provider name, a customEndpoints id, or an inline custom endpoint definition.

baseURL.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL without credentials, query, or fragment.

customEndpoints.description: Additional user-defined OpenAI-compatible API endpoints, referenced by id via provider.

id.description: Unique id used by the provider field; must not collide with built-in provider names.

baseURL.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL without credentials, query, or fragment.

apiKeyEnv.description: Environment variable holding the API key; falls back to CODEFARMER_API_KEY and the local credentials file.

apiKeyOptional.description: Set true for local keyless endpoints (e.g. Ollama, vLLM) to skip the API key check.

reasoning.description: Reasoning effort. Defaults to high for deeper thinking; lower levels reduce reasoning and completion tokens.

verbosity.description: Text response detail level. Lower values reduce output tokens.

reasoningSummary.description: Visible reasoning summary detail. 'none' omits summaries and reduces output tokens.

store.description: CodeFarmer v1 requires server-side response state for previous_response_id continuation.

autoCompact.description: Automatically compress the early part of a session once it grows past the autoCompact thresholds, before a turn runs.

autoCompactMinMessages.description: Auto-compact once the stored conversation exceeds this many messages.

autoCompactMinChars.description: Auto-compact once the stored message content exceeds this many characters.

budgetUsd.description: Optional per-session cost ceiling in USD. Once the cumulative estimated cost of a session reaches this amount, new turns are refused until the budget is raised or a new session starts.
